sourceItems.title: 2019年12月中国采购经理指数运行情况
normalizedClaims: December manufacturing PMI was 50.2; production 53.2 and new orders 51.2, with new orders above 50 for a second month while small-enterprise PMI remained 47.2.

sourceItems.title: 2019年11月份居民消费价格同比上涨4.5%
normalizedClaims: November pork prices rose 110.2% YoY and 3.8% MoM; livestock meat prices rose 74.5% YoY, showing an extreme hog-supply/price regime.

sourceItems.title: 2019年11月汽车工业经济运行情况
normalizedClaims: November NEV sales were 95k, down 43.7% YoY; Jan-Nov auto-industry key-enterprise revenue was down 5% and profits/taxes down 19%, while commercial vehicles were less weak.

sourceItems.title: Decline in Q4 DRAM Contract Prices Lessens as Buying Momentum Recovers
normalizedClaims: Q4 DRAM ASP decline had narrowed to about 5%, October trading volume rose materially QoQ, buyers were more willing to pay, and lower supplier inventories could allow prices to stabilize/recover in 2020.

sourceItems.title: As Spot Prices See Sharp Upturn, 1Q20 DRAM Contract Prices Stop Falling
normalizedClaims: DRAM spot prices had begun to rebound; buyers were raising inventory, and TrendForce expected the cyclical price upturn to begin with server DRAM while most other DRAM categories were closer to flat/slightly down in 1Q20.
observedChanges: server DRAM becomes first clear product-level upturn

sourceItems.title: 中国工程机械工业协会：11月挖掘机销量同比增21.7%
normalizedClaims: November excavator sales were 19,316 units, +21.7% YoY; domestic +21.2%, exports +25.6%; Jan-Nov total +15.0% and exports +36.6%.

sourceItems.title: 首批国产特斯拉Model 3正式交付，相关产业链迎“黄金期”
normalizedClaims: Shanghai-made Model 3 began first internal-customer deliveries earlier than the previously expected 2020Q1 timing; domestic suppliers were already being discussed as a growing part of the localized supply chain.
observedChanges: Tesla China production moves from construction to realized delivery
localization opportunity becomes operational rather than conceptual

sourceItems.title: 中国优质供应商将充实特斯拉全球供应链
normalizedClaims: Tesla Shanghai had entered trial production; Chinese Model 3 was expected to begin small-scale delivery by year end and larger delivery in 2020Q1, with supply-chain localization expected to deepen.
observedChanges: localized EV supply chain moves toward production ramp

eventClusters.statement: The DRAM downcycle was visibly bottoming: Q4 price declines narrowed, buyer restocking increased, and by mid-December server DRAM was identified as the first product segment likely to return to price growth.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Broader DRAM recovery was uneven: server DRAM led while PC/mobile categories were not yet clearly rising. Deep research must preserve product-level distinctions instead of mapping a single server signal to every memory-theme stock.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which A-share expressions, if any, have direct earnings sensitivity to the specific product segments turning up, and should a broader memory hypothesis be separated from server DRAM?

eventClusters.statement: Tesla Shanghai moved from trial production to realized Model 3 delivery by year end, bringing the domestic supply-chain localization thesis from expectation into an observable production ramp.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Many listed companies were described as Tesla-related with very different revenue materiality. Deep research must verify actual supply content and incremental earnings rather than accept concept exposure.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which domestic suppliers had already-verifiable Tesla content with material incremental earnings and acceptable expectation burden?

eventClusters.statement: Excavator demand reaccelerated sharply in November, with domestic and export sales both above 20% YoY and Jan-Nov volume already 15% above the prior year.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The industry had already been strong for several years, so deep research must distinguish continuing structural/share gains from a late-cycle volume peak.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Do leading OEM/component companies still have earnings-path room beyond the already-visible machinery cycle?

eventClusters.statement: Pork prices remained in an extreme scarcity regime, rising 110.2% YoY in November, creating a potentially large producer margin pool but also a strong incentive for supply restoration.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The price signal is extremely visible and may be late-cycle. Deep research must test biological inventory/capacity restoration and whether listed producers' volume survival is strong enough to monetize high prices.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Are high pork prices still an investable earnings inflection, or already a late-cycle scarcity headline?

eventClusters.statement: China NEV demand remained deeply weak in November, with sales down 43.7% YoY and broad auto-industry revenue/profits still under pressure.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Tesla localization is a separate company/supply-chain event and should not be used to declare the whole NEV market healthy.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Should broad domestic NEV exposure remain fail-closed while selectively researching Tesla-localization beneficiaries?

eventClusters.statement: China manufacturing PMI stabilized above 50 with production and new orders expanding, but small firms remained below the threshold, making this broad context rather than a standalone sector thesis.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Aggregate stabilization can coexist with sector divergence; require narrower physical and earnings evidence.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which narrow industries show independent physical acceleration beyond the macro PMI context?
